source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: net-snmp + vendor MIB + BMC SNMP enabled (2nd host)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SysInfo MIB data browses vendor BMC MIB data with a MIB browser (e.g. iReasoning) from a management host after SNMP is enabled; agent can instead read the equivalent Redfish inventory: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Systems/system 2>&1 | head -60 and the BMC MIB subtree once the vendor MIB + community are configured on the 2nd host.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL Redfish system-inventory JSON + (if present) the snmpwalk of the vendor MIB root so the user confirms the "+it+" data is complete and matches.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: requires the vendor SNMP MIB + a MIB-browser host and an enabled BMC SNMP agent; the Redfish read is the agent-provided alternative evidence.

original_test_intent: Retrieve a finite, Project-approved set of BMC system-information objects over SNMPv3 and verify identity, platform and firmware fields against their authoritative inventory sources while preserving field sensitivity and completeness rules.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on undefined `$target`; Criteria switch to Net-SNMP without identifying the SysInfo fields or expected values.
manual_activity: An engineer must configure SNMPv3 and approve the finite SysInfo field, sensitivity, expected-source and normalization contract. The agent can then query exact objects and compare them; any Redfish evidence remains a separately mapped cross-check.
required_inputs: vendor SysInfo MIB module/version and finite numeric OID/index list
ASN.1 types plus model, serial, asset, UUID, hostname, firmware and management-identity semantics in scope
authoritative source and expected value per field
normalization for whitespace, case, version format, absent/unknown and multi-instance values
approved IReasoning/Net-SNMP equivalence and optional Redfish property mapping
safety_requirements: Keep collection read-only and finite; do not walk an unspecified vendor MIB root or query write-capable identity/configuration objects.
Do not run DeepSeek's `curl -k -u` command, assume `/redfish/v1/Systems/system`, expose credentials or truncate JSON with `head` while claiming completeness.
Protect serials, UUIDs, asset tags, hostnames, firmware inventory and management identifiers according to policy while preserving stable comparison tokens.
Do not execute the generic source `Clear logs` step automatically; it is unrelated to SysInfo value validation and may destroy evidence.
Do not infer equality from similar display text: compare typed normalized values to the declared authoritative source and retain missing/extra fields.
Stop on unbounded output, unexpected write access, identity conflict, TLS/authentication failure or BMC instability; preserve discrepancy evidence and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, resolve and query each approved SysInfo object with bounded SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT and retain complete typed/indexed values.
Normalize per the approved field rules, compare with authoritative inventory and report missing, duplicate, stale or conflicting fields.
If Redfish is approved, discover the resource securely, validate CA/authentication and compare only explicitly mapped properties as separate corroboration.
Do not operate WebUI, change identity/configuration, claim cross-interface equivalence without mapping or issue a DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the finite field/schema/sensitivity list and authoritative expected values/normalization.
Configure/restore SNMPv3, approve IReasoning versus Net-SNMP equivalence and any Redfish property mapping/CA policy.
Resolve authoritative-source conflicts and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The hard-coded Redfish resource, TLS bypass, command-line credentials, first-60-line truncation and broad vendor-root suggestion cannot prove complete SNMP SysInfo object coverage or secure semantic equivalence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an exact finite vendor-MIB SNMPv3 object list with full typed values and explicit field normalization; use securely discovered Redfish properties only as mapped independent cross-checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria, source clear instruction and 10/5-minute values remain preserved evidence rather than rewritten.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT SYSINFO SCHEMA AND AUTHORITY MAP REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define required and optional SysInfo fields, bind each to exact OID/type/index, sensitivity and authoritative expected source, collect bounded SNMPv3 values and compare normalized data with explicit completeness reporting.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified BMC/platform firmware and matching vendor SysInfo MIB.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, MIB module, client and authoritative inventory revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SysInfo MIB, platform FRU/firmware inventory specification and Project field matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds finite schema, sensitivity, per-field authority, normalization and completeness without replacing the source's SNMP/IReasoning coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Redfish can corroborate mapped properties but cannot prove SNMP transport, OID availability/type or IReasoning interaction; truncated or partial output cannot prove completeness.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Objects/schema/sensitivity, authority/expected values, normalization, client/interface decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cross-interface names, version formatting, absent values and update cadence can differ legitimately and require field-specific rules.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may select its required SysInfo subset and approve Net-SNMP or Redfish corroboration, but must record original/actual tool/interface, reason, per-field equivalence, omitted fields and any unverified SNMP/IReasoning coverage. Redfish-only execution cannot be called full source coverage.
expected_evidence: approved finite required/optional SysInfo schema with sensitivity and completeness rules
redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with exact OID/type/index/field mapping
complete bounded typed SNMPv3 values with field-level redaction tokens
normalized comparison to authoritative inventory including missing/extra/conflicting fields
secure discovered Redfish mapping/CA evidence only if approved, plus tool/coverage statement, BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria changes to Net-SNMP, `$target` and completeness are undefined, and DeepSeek substitutes unsafe/truncated Redfish plus a broad MIB-root walk. The finite read-only SysInfo purpose remains identifiable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field list, expected values, sensitivity, normalization and interface mapping are normal Project execution-readiness inputs for a clear read-only SysInfo purpose. Once supplied and manually configured, bounded collection/comparison is automatable, so permanent BLOCKED is not justified.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains hybrid execution but rejects the assumed Redfish resource, TLS bypass, credentials, truncation and broad walk; restores SNMP as the primary coverage path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while preserving strict execution gates until the finite schema and authority map exist.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms its classification and strengthens sensitivity, required-versus-optional completeness and cross-interface non-equivalence.

review_improvement: Turns vague `SysInfo` into a finite field-level evidence contract that can distinguish missing SNMP objects, legitimate formatting differences and conflicting authoritative data without leaking platform identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: System information is broad, but the operation—read BMC SysInfo through SNMP—is clear. The Project can supply the required field set and authority map; those inputs do not justify permanent BLOCKED. Manual SNMPv3 setup plus deterministic bounded queries therefore fits REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.
